run: Labelled under the identical branch rule (stem + every terminal). Because each test set is drawn from the reference clade itself, these runs use all remaining branches as reference (55-67 branches) rather than the 38-branch RGM plus SGM reference of S11. Their likelihood-ratio statistics are not on the same scale as those in S11 and are reported for the K values only. All four return K above 1, which means that a departure from K = 1 is readily obtained on this alignment without any reduction. Rerunning the published FSM labelling under this same all-remaining-branches reference reproduced its branch sets exactly and gave K = 1.041, against 1.044 for FSM under the corrected common reference in S11.
